data.body: **[P2] Keep weakref-acquired owners alive until after unlocking.** Removing weakref callbacks does not eliminate reentrant finalization: if another thread releases a plugin after `lane_ref()` temporarily acquires its lane, this comprehension can drop the last strong reference while `_exporter_owner_lock` is held. The lane then releases its custom exporter, whose `__del__` may construct another plugin or take an inverse lock, deadlocking plugin creation. Materialize all live owners into a strong-reference list retained beyond the `with` block, rebuild the weakref registry from it, and add a concurrent-finalization regression.
